column2: It is not forced into each attack that turn.
column3: Outdated (its first two sentences, about creatures that attack "each turn" if able): the Ixalan Oracle Changes (Eli Shiffrin, 2017-09-28) changed the 60 cards that attacked or blocked "each turn" to "each combat", so no card has that requirement any more; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md. The last sentence ("each combat") still holds and is cited in tests/rulings/r_p055_combat_phases.rs
